shipment.description:
**DAG-root waiver (Stage, 2026-10-03, dark-mode Orchestrator decision).**
`196-S` is a reasoned exception, not a predecessor-free root like `182-S`: it
follows shipped `195-S` (merge `58f5bdba`, PR #471). The `dag-root` label
waives the topology gate's predecessor-closure check for `196-S` only. A
`blocks` edge onto `195-S` fails `PREDECESSOR_CLOSURE_INCOMPLETE` because the
`195-S` closure (`docs/closure/195-S-claim-start-proof-post-merge-closure.md`)
is `READY_WITH_CONDITIONS` with no machine-readable satisfied `conditions:`
block. Those conditions include `227A2930` and `B83081F5`, which only `196-S`
discharges, while `359D8F32` remains separately open and is not covered by
`196-S`. Lineage is a non-gating `related_to` link; do not add a `blocks`
edge onto `195-S`. `359D8F32` (the P-020 `target: all` compaction candidate
review) does not gate successors, because P-020 treats incomplete compaction as
non-blocking `degraded`. The waiver therefore accepts no obligation that P-020
would block. Proceeding while it stays open is a recorded P-017 dark-mode
Orchestrator decision under the operator's `196-S` scope, and `359D8F32`
remains open for a later Stage cycle.

**Post-merge closure note for Ship.** During `196-S` post-merge closure, Ship
should record in the `195-S` closure artifact (or in the `196-S` closure
artifact, referencing it) that `227A2930` and `B83081F5` were discharged by the
`196-S` merge SHA; `359D8F32` stays open.

members.title: 195-S follow-up: Orchestrator served-root handoff and explicit-feature reconcile contract (227A2930, B83081F5)
members.description:
<!-- BEGIN:description -->
Covering feature for the two 195-S READY_WITH_CONDITIONS follow-ups that block the next autonomous pipeline cycle. Source stash entries: 227A2930 (served-root handoff; harvested into U2, with Ship use-time attestation in U8/U9 and surface pin U7) and B83081F5 (explicit-feature reconcile; harvested into U5). No production Go change, no new lifecycle authority, no new MCP surface.

1. Served-root handoff (227A2930): every Orchestrator invocation of Ship (Step 2 item 5, Step 0.0b item 6 agent: ship, Dark Factory blocked-shipment routing, and operator `ship {id}` naming a non-queued shipment) first runs one named read-only Served-Root Handoff Procedure: resolve both absolute served roots, validate them, run the authoritative read-only Served-Root Attestation against the MCP server's own self-report (backlogit_get_metadata_catalog workspace.root_path and workspace.storage_root, plus backlogit_query_sql pragma_database_list naming <storage_root>/backlogit.db) before any raw read, then a static manifest/MCP agreement check, and pass served_workspace_root and served_storage_root plus informational evidence to Ship. Any failure, error, or indeterminate result halts with SERVED_ROOTS_UNRESOLVED. Ship never treats the evidence as proof: it re-runs the attestation once per wave admission, repeats the pragma check at each task claim, and re-attests before the Step 4.1b CLI fallback, halting with SERVED_ROOT_ATTESTATION_FAILED.
2. Explicit-feature reconcile (B83081F5): shipment-reconcile pre-close and safe-close accept an active explicit feature member as feature-pending-governed-completion when at least one explicit task member exists and every explicit task member is matched or pre-archived; governed ShipShipment completes and archives it. Every other feature state still halts.

Plan: docs/exec-plans/2026-10-03-195s-dispatch-closure-contract-plan.md (plan-review attempt 3 ADVISORY, operator 'Approved' 2026-10-03T08:00:44Z; Amendment 1 delta review ADVISORY 0 P0 / 0 P1 / 6 P2 / 5 P3, operator_authorization: approved via operator directive 'PR 474: Additional Copilot review comments to fix' 2026-10-03T21:07-07:00 relayed by the Orchestrator). Decision: docs/decisions/2026-10-03-195s-dispatch-closure-contract-deliberation.md (options P1-A and P2-A; Amendment 1 replaces the content-equality binding with the Served-Root Attestation).

Out of scope (tracked separately): direct-Ship served-root intake, served-root halt mappings and policy mirror, payload key pinning, and attestation of Ship's other backlogit invocations (follow-up stash CDBCB258), 41FE00A1 (Step 1.5 continuity allowlist), 731CE551 (model-routing re-render), 359D8F32 (docs compaction).
<!-- END:description -->

<!-- BEGIN:dod -->
All nine child tasks done; U1, U3, and U8 RED before and GREEN after U2, U5, and U9; U4 and U7 GREEN on current code (or P-021 DEFERRED SCOPE EXPANSION halt); manifest drift records match installed hashes; full quality gates green (gofmt, go vet, golangci-lint, go test -timeout=30m ./...; markdownlint).

Bootstrap dispatch precondition (plan 'Exception and Dispatch Preconditions'): this shipment is dispatched before U2 lands; the dispatching Orchestrator applies R1-R8 from the reviewed plan only after recording explicit operator authorization (a P-017 dark-mode bounded scope naming this shipment counts), citing the plan path, the commit carrying Amendment 1, and the pass result of each step a-f in workspace-relative form; otherwise halt SERVED_ROOTS_UNRESOLVED. Until U9 is merged to main and loaded as Ship's served agent text, Ship applies R14 from the plan throughout this shipment (the Ship payload must cite the plan path and R14); failure halts SERVED_ROOT_ATTESTATION_FAILED.

Closure precondition (this shipment only): before Ship Step 6 pre-close, Ship confirms the local checkout contains the PR merge commit, shipment-reconcile SKILL.md contains feature-pending-governed-completion, and the binary that runs ShipShipment descends from 47dfcc93 (git merge-base --is-ancestor exit 0 only). Otherwise halt RECONCILE_CONTRACT_NOT_IN_FORCE; do not ask Stage to move the feature. Runtime closure: this shipment's own pre-close classifies its feature feature-pending-governed-completion and proceeds.
<!-- END:dod -->

<!-- BEGIN:goals -->
Nine tests-first units (<=2h each, ~18h) in four waves: {U1, U3, U4, U7, U8} -> {U2, U5} -> {U9} -> {U6}. Dependency edges: U2 blocks-on U1 and U7; U5 blocks-on U3 and U4; U9 blocks-on U8, U7, and U5; U6 blocks-on U2, U5, and U9.
